evals.prompt: I've got a bunch of uncommitted changes on my current branch. Open a PR for them.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the working tree, proposes a branch + atomic commit split + a drafted PR description, and only creates a draft PR after the user approves the consolidated plan.
assertions: Inspects working tree first (git status / git diff against the base branch) before asking anything
Presents a consolidated Gate-2 plan (branch name + commit split + PR description) for approval before running any command
Does not commit, push, or open the PR until the user approves the plan
Creates the PR as a draft (gh pr create --draft), not a ready-for-review PR

evals.prompt: Cut a PR for my changes — but the diff has both a bug fix and an unrelated refactor mixed together.
evals.expected_output: Detects the two distinct concerns and offers to split them into one branch + commits + draft PR per concern, rather than bundling everything into one PR.
assertions: Flags that the change spans more than one distinct concern
Offers a choice between one PR and splitting into per-concern branches/PRs
If splitting, each concern gets its own atomic commits and its own draft PR
Commit messages are conventional-commit style with a scope (e.g. fix(...) / refactor(...))

evals.prompt: Ship these changes as a PR, and run a review over them first.
evals.expected_output: Runs an independent agent review in a subagent, applies only high-confidence fixes to the working tree, summarizes the rest in an 'Agent review' section of the PR, then proceeds to the branch/commit/draft-PR flow.
assertions: Runs the review in a separate subagent, not as self-review by the implementing agent
Auto-applies only high-confidence fixes; uncertain findings are reported, not applied
Re-reads the diff after the review before computing the commit split and PR description
Adds an 'Agent review' section (coverage + findings + verdict) to the PR description

evals.prompt: Commit and PR this. Please reuse the repo's pull request template for the description.
evals.expected_output: Reads the repo's PR template and drafts the description using its sections, filling conditional sections only when relevant and leaving no placeholder text.
assertions: Reads the repo PR template (e.g. .github/pull_request_template.md) and uses its sections as the structure
Fills conditional sections (env vars, dependencies) only when the diff actually contains them
Verifies no leftover template placeholder text remains before showing the plan
Keeps the description concise rather than a line-by-line code walkthrough

evals.prompt: Package my working-tree changes into a draft PR against main.
evals.expected_output: Creates a branch, atomic commits, and a draft PR based on main; conventional commit messages carry no issue reference while any linked-issue reference goes only in the PR body's motivation section.
assertions: Creates a draft PR with the base branch set to main
Branch name and commit messages contain no issue reference / ticket ID
Any linked-issue reference appears only in the PR description's 'why'/motivation section
Aborts gracefully if the working tree is clean or HEAD is detached
